request.subject: ICON:CURIOSITY:SEA_SERPENT

layers.text: Erase everything except the sea serpent: remove the brown soil block, the green grass and the blue water under it completely, so the serpent's neck and hump stand directly on a transparent background with only a thin line of white foam at their bottom. Keep the serpent's head, its eye, its fin crest, its hump, the outline and the art style exactly the same.
